name: Phu Quoc food guide
summary: Bún quây is the morning bowl: rice-flour noodles, seafood, and a sauce you mix. Dinner is ghẹ Hàm Ninh, gỏi cá trích, and the catch at the night market. Fish sauce and pepper are the pantry. Where a price was not printed, it is Check on arrival.
body: Start with bún quây. Vietnam National Authority of Tourism says it arrived from central Vietnam in 1955 as ground shrimp, was called bún tôm until 1996, and is now served through the day and into the evening. Eat it on the street across from the Dương Đông harbour, or along Long Beach. The sauce is chili, sugar, fish sauce, and citrus.

The seafood account then names grilled nhum, gỏi cá trích, ghẹ Hàm Ninh, tôm mũ ni, ốc, and cá sòng nướng. The nature account adds bún kèn, grilled oysters with echinus, and honey coffee at a bee farm. The whisper account adds grilled cobia. Cục Du lịch Quốc gia Việt Nam adds cùi biên mai nướng, rượu sim, and cá suối. The night account adds cashew nuts, dried seaweed, and squid to the list of things to buy.

Fish sauce keeps every figure. Hội nước mắm Phú Quốc says 20–43 gN/lít and up to 40°N. Cục Du lịch Quốc gia Việt Nam says over 10 million litres a year. The district account says about 6 million litres and nitrogen trên 25ºC. The association says the Gulf of Thailand. Vietnam National Authority of Tourism’s fish-sauce account says the clear Andaman Sea. Pepper is over 1,000 tons a year on the 3-day account. A price on every plate is Check on arrival.
specialtiesLead: Bún quây, nước mắm, and hồ tiêu come first. The other specialties follow. The street is here when a publisher printed one.

sections.heading: Bowls and seafood
paragraphs: These are the bowls and plates Vietnam National Authority of Tourism and Cục Du lịch Quốc gia Việt Nam name. An hour that was not printed is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Bun quay
spots.address: Dương Đông harbour street, and Long Beach
spots.note: Rice-flour noodles, fish, shrimp, squid, herbs, and onion. Mix chili, sugar, fish sauce, and citrus. Traditionally morning, and now through the day and into the evening. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Bun ken
spots.note: A noodle with Cambodian origins. The broth is dried fish, coconut milk, and a dash of curry powder. No street was printed. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Goi ca trich
spots.note: Raw herring in rice paper. The specialty-seafood account adds shredded coconut, mint, onion, and a fish-sauce dip. The nature account does not mention coconut. Lunch or dinner by the water on that account, and any time of day on the other. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Ghe Ham Ninh
spots.note: Boiled crab with lime and pepper. One account says 20 km northeast of Dương Đông. The specialty-seafood account says 20 km from Duong Dong town. Both stay. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Nhum bien
spots.note: Grilled sea urchin with peanuts and spring onion, dipped in lime and pepper. The nature account serves echinus with grilled oysters, shallots, peanuts, and green onion. The day account says frilled sea urchin and prints no method. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Grilled oysters
spots.note: The nature account serves grilled oysters with echinus, roasted shallots, peanuts, and green onion. A Vietnamese name was not printed. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Ca song nuong
spots.note: Grilled Trachurus with salt and chili, wrapped in rice paper with herbs. The nature account names lunch or dinner by the water and prints no seasoning. No beach was named. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Tom mu ni
spots.note: Boiled slipper lobster, clawless, dipped in lime, salt, and Phú Quốc pepper. No door was named. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Oc
spots.note: Sea snails. No species and no cooking method were printed. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Grilled cobia
spots.note: The whisper account lists grilled cobia with sea urchin and herring salad. A Vietnamese name and a method beyond grilled were not printed. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Squid
spots.address: Dinh Cau night market, or back on shore after a night catch
spots.note: The underwater account says you eat the squid you catch, back on shore. The night account says to buy squid at the market. A cooking method was not printed. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Ca suoi
spots.note: Stream fish, named with sim wine and the grilled seed. Suối Tranh, suối Đá Bàn, and suối Đá Ngọn are the streams. Which one has the kitchen was not printed. A price is Check on arrival.

sections.heading: Pantry, drinks, and snacks
paragraphs: Fish sauce, pepper, and sim wine are the things the island sends you home with. Cashew nuts and dried seaweed are on the same night-market list. Bãi Thơm’s coconut, hotpot, and seafood platter had no Vietnamese names.

spots.name: Nuoc mam Phu Quoc
spots.address: Barrel houses along the old Dương Đông river
spots.note: Anchovy sauce from wooden vats. Nitrogen 20–43 gN/lít and up to 40°N. Over 10 million litres a year, and about 6 million litres, both stay. The Gulf of Thailand and the clear Andaman Sea both stay. A bottle price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Ho tieu
spots.note: Aromatic and spicy, a floral aroma and intense heat, and pungent and spicy. All three stay. The 3-day account says over 1,000 tons a year. No commune was printed. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Ruou sim
spots.address: Bãi Sao, the national park, and the Dinh Cau night market
spots.note: Forest sim wine. The night account calls it myrtle wine. A strength was not printed. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Cui bien mai nuong
spots.address: Bãi Sao and the national park
spots.note: A grilled local seed. A botanical name was not printed. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Honey coffee
spots.note: Coffee and sweets with island honey, tasted while walking the hives. A Vietnamese name was not printed. Not shown to be breakfast. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Cashew nuts
spots.note: Listed with the fish sauce and the pepper as something to buy. A preparation was not printed. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Dried seaweed
spots.note: Listed with the fish sauce and the pepper as something to buy. A cooking method was not printed. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Coconut
spots.note: A stop on the northern tip, named with a hotpot and a seafood platter. A Vietnamese name was not printed. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Beach hotpot
spots.note: A hotpot on the beach. Ingredients were not printed. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Seafood platter
spots.note: A seafood platter on the beach. The fish were not named. A price is Check on arrival.

sections.heading: International dining
paragraphs: Vietnam National Authority of Tourism says Western food is served along Bãi Sao and Long Beach, and names no door. The whisper account says high-end beachfront salons offer Japanese-French fusion and grilled beef, and names no door. A price is Check on arrival.

sections.heading: Casual dining
paragraphs: Three market names were not shown to be one gate. The 3-day account puts the Phu Quoc Night Market on Bạch Đằng in Dương Đông, pedestrian in the evening, with 50-plus stalls, and prints no clock. The night account says the streets near Dinh Cậu are closed to traffic from 5 pm until midnight, with 100-odd stalls, and more than half sell food. The day account says more than a hundred vendors. The nature account says Dương Đông seafood market and prints no street. All of the counts stay.

spots.name: Dinh Cau night market
spots.note: Vietnam National Authority of Tourism says the streets near the rock temple are closed to traffic from 5 pm until midnight. More than half of the 100-odd stalls sell food. A street number is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Phu Quoc Night Market
spots.note: The 3-day account puts this market on Bạch Đằng, pedestrian in the evening, with 50-plus stalls selling seafood and local dishes. It prints no clock. Check on arrival.

spots.name: Duong Dong seafood market
spots.note: The nature account says the day’s catch is grilled, boiled, steamed, and stir-fried. No street and no clock were printed. Check on arrival.

spots.name: Rach Vem
spots.note: The island-hopping account puts floating restaurants on Rach Vem Beach, the village next to Starfish Beach. The 3-day account puts starfish beach in Rach Vem fishing village, about 20 km north of Duong Dong, and says the catch is cooked on the spot. Both stay. An hour is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Long Beach
spots.note: Food, drink, and cocktails along the sand. The day account says dinner is served on white tablecloths and on plastic stools. Western food is named here and no menu was printed. Sunset into the evening. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Sao Beach
spots.note: Western and Vietnamese food along the beach, plus cùi biên mai nướng and rượu sim. The 3-day account says entrance and parking are free. No other opened account prints a beach ticket, so a fee is Check on arrival. A meal hour was not printed.

spots.name: Bai Thom
spots.note: A coconut, a hotpot, or a seafood platter. No door was named. An hour is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Ham Ninh
spots.note: Ghẹ luộc with muối tiêu chanh. One account says 20 km northeast. The specialty-seafood account says 20 km from Duong Dong town. Crab is there almost all the time on the village account. A price is Check on arrival.

sections.heading: Fine dining
paragraphs: Vietnam National Authority of Tourism says the island has fine-dining meals, that many hotels serve gourmet food beside the sea, and that a beach barbecue is set on the sand. The whisper account says high-end beachfront salons exist. No door was named. A price is Check on arrival.

sections.heading: Breakfast
paragraphs: Bún quây is the breakfast that was named. Vietnam National Authority of Tourism says it is traditionally a morning bowl and is now served through the day and into the evening. A second breakfast dish was not named. The hour at a given door is Check on arrival.

seoTitle: Phu Quoc food guide — bun quay, fish sauce, and the night market
seoDescription: Bún quây, nước mắm, ghẹ Hàm Ninh, and the Dinh Cậu night market. Twenty-two specialties are named. A price that was not printed is Check on arrival.
